datasets.title: Sierra Leone Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 742.5 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 74% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 8 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 6% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and validated using AI-mapping estimates to assess coverage completeness. Data was compiled and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage) for national-scale exposure assessment.
